svg.title: Mitotic recombination and twin spots
svg.desc: Two replicated homologs carry aB and Ab. The two inner nonsister chromatids exchange material between their centromeres and both loci. When the exchanged chromatids go to the same daughter, both daughters are aB/Ab. When they go to different daughters, one is aB/aB and the other is Ab/Ab. These daughters can give rise to twin spots.
